queries.query: site:gujarat.gov.in Gandhinagar cadastral parcel map GIS official land records AnyROR
queries.result: Found the official Gandhinagar District land-records page. It states that cadastral survey was completed for Gujarat, identifies local e-Dhara land-record administration, and links to AnyRoR Gujarat. Search also found the official Gandhinagar Smart City GIS portal with plot/property lookup.

queries.result: Found the same official Gandhinagar District land-records service and official Smart City GIS portal, plus a Gujarat land-map directory. The official sources evidence land-record and plot/property services; no public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed by the search result.

registry.custodian: Gandhinagar District Administration / Government of Gujarat Revenue Department
registry.serviceEvidence: The district land-records page documents computerized RoR and mutation handling through taluka e-Dhara centres and links to AnyRoR. The Gandhinagar Smart City GIS page describes an authoritative municipal GIS with Know Your Property / Know Your Plots lookup.

parcelData.reason: No bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The Smart City GIS route returned 502 through the web fetcher; direct curl had an untrusted certificate chain and the HTTP route timed out. AnyRoR is a record-of-rights service and was not queried with personal, owner, address, title, tax, or other unsafe fields.

notes: Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift was attempted.
The local registry/custodian is evidenced, but source integration/admission is not established.
No sample GeoJSON retained because no safe native parcel identity and geometry were obtained.
